messages.subject: Bracken Group plc v Calderwood Industries Ltd (CL-2025-000412) - service of Particulars of Claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

We enclose by way of service the Particulars of Claim in this matter, the claim form having been issued on 21 October 2025 (Claim No. CL-2025-000412). A Schedule of Loss has been served with the Particulars. We look forward to receiving the Defence in due course.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP
